description: Which SUs, racks and trays have actually carried a Slurm job in the selected window, and how hard they were pushed. Derived from on-tray cgroup job attribution joined to DCGM.

options.content:
Collective run coverage matrix. Which scopes have actually carried a Slurm job in the selected time window, and which have not been exercised at all. Every figure is derived from on-tray cgroup job attribution over $__range, so changing the time picker changes the whole board. Scope note: pass/fail against a bus-bandwidth floor is not shown because no collective-benchmark exporter is live — this board reports exercised versus not exercised, which is measurable.
